[9:20p.m.] #IkoroduRoad #TrafficUpdate 

Traffic is quite fluid as you descend the Dorman Long Bridge inwards Fadeyi and move through Onipan, Palmgrove, Obanikoro, Anthony, Odiroko, Harbour works through the Independence Tunnel inwards Odo Iyalaro.

Traffic on the service lane from Anthony through Maryland Mall adjoining Mobolaji Bank Anthony Way is good.

Traffic is good to Ojota and the Interchange.

Our Men are strategically positioned to ensure you have it smooth all the way home.
